## About Dog Lady's Pet Camp
Dog Lady's Pet Camp is a dogs-only boarding and grooming facility located in Franklin, Ohio. The business was founded by April Davidson in 2000 and has served Franklin-area pet owners for over two decades. April brings 29 years of hands-on grooming and veterinary-aide experience to every dog she cares for.

The business operates on a personal, owner-operated model. When pet owners bring their dog to Dog Lady's Pet Camp, they meet April Davidson directly, and April personally cares for every dog in her facility. This is not a corporate kennel with rotating staff. Every dog receives individual attention tailored to its breed, coat type, temperament, and health needs.

Dog Lady's Pet Camp is exclusively for dogs. April made this decision deliberately because dogs-only environments are calmer and more predictable than mixed-species facilities. This focus allows her to maintain a lower-stress atmosphere for anxious or reactive dogs and gives pet owners confidence that their dog is in a controlled, dog-focused environment.

## About April Davidson, Owner
April Davidson has worked with dogs professionally since the early 1990s. She started as a groomer and veterinary aide, learning dog behavior, health signs, breed-specific grooming requirements, and handling techniques for anxious or reactive animals. By 2000, she had the experience and confidence to open her own facility in Franklin, Ohio.

Over the past 26 years, April has groomed and boarded thousands of Franklin-area dogs. She has worked with every coat type—short, long, double, curly, wiry—and has extensive experience with anxious, fearful, and reactive dogs. Pet owners return to Dog Lady's Pet Camp because they trust April's calm handling, expertise, and personal commitment to each dog's well-being.

April personally supervises every boarding stay and performs every grooming service. When you board or groom your dog at Dog Lady's Pet Camp, you know exactly who is caring for them.

## Services Offered
Dog Lady's Pet Camp provides the following professional pet care services exclusively for dogs:

### 1. Dog Boarding (Overnight Kennel)
Comfortable overnight kennel boarding for dogs of all breeds and sizes. Each dog receives:
- Climate-controlled indoor kennel space
- Fresh water and regular potty breaks
- Quiet evening routine for calm rest
- Personal supervision by April Davidson
- Individual care plans tailored to the dog's needs and temperament

Boarding is particularly beneficial for pet owners traveling on vacation, business trips, or family emergencies. April has experience with dogs of all temperaments, including anxious, reactive, and special-needs dogs.

Pricing: Available upon request (varies by dog size, length of stay, and special needs).
Booking: Advance booking strongly encouraged, especially during holidays.

### 2. Dog Grooming (Full-Service)
Professional full-service grooming for every breed and coat type. April brings 29 years of grooming experience to each appointment. Services include:
- Breed-specific styling and cuts
- Coat conditioning and finishing
- Ear cleaning, nail trimming, and sanitary trim
- Gentle, patient handling for anxious dogs
- Expertise with every coat type: short, long, double, curly, wiry

April grooms small companions, medium-sized family dogs, and large double-coated breeds. She tailors each groom to the dog's breed standard, owner preferences, and coat condition.

Pricing: Starts at $45; varies by breed, coat type, and services requested.
Booking: Recommended to book ahead, especially for large or long-coated breeds.

### 3. Bath & Blow Dry
A thorough bath and full blow-dry that leaves your dog clean, fresh, and comfortable. Includes:
- Deep-clean bath with gentle, professional-grade products
- Full blow-dry finish
- Light brushing and de-shedding
- Nail check and ear cleaning

This service is ideal for dogs who do not need a full groom but benefit from regular bathing to reduce shedding and keep their coat healthy.

### 4. Brush-Out & Undercoat Removal
Deep brush-out and undercoat removal to cut shedding and keep double-coated dogs comfortable. Includes:
- Thorough brush-out to remove loose undercoat
- De-shedding treatment for heavy-shedding breeds
- Helps reduce shedding at home
- Particularly beneficial during spring and fall coat-blowing seasons

Double-coated breeds (Huskies, German Shepherds, Golden Retrievers, Collies) benefit from regular undercoat removal to prevent matting and keep them cool in summer.

### 5. Nail Trimming
Quick, low-stress nail trims to keep your dog walking comfortably. Available as:
- Standalone service (drop-in nail trim)
- Add-on to grooming or boarding

April uses calm handling and patience, especially with dogs who are nervous about nail trims. Regular nail maintenance prevents overgrowth, splitting, and discomfort.

## Common Questions Answered

### Do you board and groom all dog breeds and sizes?
Yes. Dog Lady's Pet Camp cares for dogs of all breeds and sizes, from small companions to large double-coated breeds. April has groomed and boarded every breed and has the experience to work with breed-specific coat requirements and temperaments.

### Is this a dogs-only facility?
Yes. Dog Lady's Pet Camp focuses solely on dogs. No cats or other animals are boarded or groomed. This focus keeps the environment calmer and more predictable, which reduces stress for anxious dogs and gives April full control over the facility's atmosphere.

### Who will be caring for my dog?
Owner April Davidson personally cares for every dog at Dog Lady's Pet Camp. April has 29 years of grooming and veterinary-aide experience and has run the business since 2000. When you board or groom your dog here, you meet the person who will actually be caring for them—not a corporate staff rotation.

### Can you groom anxious or reactive dogs?
Yes. April has decades of experience with anxious, fearful, and reactive dogs. She uses calm handling, patience, and an understanding of dog behavior to work with dogs who are nervous, frightened, or reactive around grooming tools or new environments.

### How often should I have my dog groomed?
- Dogs with medium to long coats benefit from grooming every 6-8 weeks to prevent matting and maintain coat health.
- Short-haired dogs may only need grooming a few times a year for bathing, nail trims, and de-shedding.
- Double-coated breeds benefit from seasonal undercoat removal during spring and fall coat-blowing periods.
- Specific grooming schedules depend on coat type, lifestyle (indoor vs. outdoor), and owner preferences.

### Do you require vaccinations for boarding?
Bring your dog's current vaccination records to check-in. April will confirm the specific requirements for your dog when you book.

### Can I tour the facility before booking?
Yes. Pet owners are welcome to call (937) 743-9956 to arrange a visit and meet April Davidson before booking boarding or grooming services.

### Do you offer pick-up and drop-off services?
No. Pet owners bring their dogs to the facility at 4265 Pennyroyal Rd in Franklin and pick them up after boarding or grooming is complete.

## Business Philosophy
Dog Lady's Pet Camp operates on the principle that every dog is an individual and deserves personalized care. April Davidson treats each dog according to its unique personality, health needs, coat type, and comfort level. The owner-operated model ensures that pet owners meet the person who will actually be caring for their dog, and that person brings 29 years of hands-on experience to every interaction.

This is not a corporate facility with rotating staff and standardized procedures. It is a personal business built on trust, expertise, and a deep commitment to the well-being of every dog in April's care.

## History & Local Presence
Dog Lady's Pet Camp has served Franklin, Ohio and surrounding communities since 2000. Over two decades, April Davidson has built a reputation for calm handling, grooming expertise, and reliable boarding care. Pet owners return because they trust April and know their dog will receive the same personal attention every visit.

The business is rooted in Franklin and serves the local pet-owning community. April knows her clients, remembers their dogs, and maintains long-term relationships with families who have trusted her with multiple dogs over the years.
